 Bench At Jaipur

sentences.text:
(At Present Petitioner Confined At Central Jail Jaipur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus The State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nikhil Sharma  Mr. Sanjay Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Meena, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN  Order 19/08/2023 1.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.,
who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.359/2023 registered at Police Station Karni Vihar,
District Jaipur for the offence under Section 376 IPC.
2.
It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that the accused-petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
He submits that petitioner is tenant in the house of the complainant.

He further submits that alleged incident took place on 08.05.2023, while the matter has been reported to the police on 26.05.2023, after a delay of 18 days, for which no proper explanation has been given.
Learned counsel submits that there is no medical corroboration of the allegations levelled by the prosecutrix.
He further submits that chargesheet has been filed in this case.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor assisted by learned counsel for the complainant opposed the bail application and submits that some (2 of 2) [CRLMB-7817/2023] CCTV footage are available on record, in which, it is visible that petitioner has entered in the house portion of the complainant.
They also submit that there is specific allegation of commission of rape against the petitioner.

sentences.text: Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case

; considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the petitioner and especially the fact that prosecutrix,
who is a married lady has not reported the matter to the police within a reasonable time and the fact that petitioner is tenant in the house of the prosecutrix as well as looking to the fact that chargesheet has been filed in this case, but without commenting anything on merits and demerits of the case, I deem it proper to allow the bail application.

6. This bail application is accordingly allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioner - Shehdab Khan S/o Shri Saeed Khan shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court with the stipulation that he shall appear before that Court and any court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J 69-Nirmala Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
